name: IR49830 submergence-tolerant rice breeding lines, Los Baños
description: The International Rice Research Institute developed IR49830-family breeding lines that combined tolerance inherited from the Indian selection FR13A with a shorter, improved plant type. Tests reported one high-performing family member, IR49830-7-1-2-2. A line from the same family subsequently supplied the Sub1 trait to the Swarna-Sub1 breeding programme.

date.basis: The breeder report dates the IRRI evaluation to these years.

events.statement: At Los Baños, IRRI tests identified IR49830-7-1-2-2 as a line that combined high seedling submergence tolerance with a yield among the highest in the trial.
events.place_note: International Rice Research Institute, Los Baños, Philippines.

evidence.locator: pp. 749–751, abstract, Tables 1–2, and Methods text after Table 1
evidence.supports: The original report distinguishes the tested -2 line and records its yield ranking and tolerance.

earliest_record.rationale: The report dates tests of the IR49830 line family to 1990–1991 at IRRI.

links.statement: FR13A supplied the submergence-tolerance ancestry of the IR49830 family through an intervening IRRI breeding line, IR26702.

evidence.locator: pp. 749–751, abstract, Tables 1–2, and Methods text after Table 1
evidence.supports: Mackill and colleagues trace the source of tolerance for the IR49830 cross to IR26702 and identify its FR13A ancestry.
Follow-on work on the donor identified there as line -3 confirms FR13A ancestry and demonstrates the trait's transfer. One author also appears on the 1993 report.

unresolved.note: Cambodia’s reported Popoul release concerns another line suffix in one account. The exact cultivar accession and extent of its uptake require Cambodian release and farm evidence.
